acceptance_criteria.requirement: Use a rectangular 45 mm × 30 mm board outline (dimension tolerance 0.1 mm) with two copper layers.
Use J1 with pins 1 through 4 assigned +5V, GND, CTRL1, CTRL2. Control inputs are 0 V or 3.3 V relative to GND.

For each channel i from 1 through 2, use an NPN transistor Qi with emitter to GND, collector to the cathode of LED Di, and base connected to CTRLi through a 4.7 kohm resistor. Connect a 100 kohm resistor between base and emitter. Connect +5V through a 1 kohm resistor to the anode of Di.

Use red 0805 LEDs and NPN transistors in SOT-23 packages. Name the transistor part and verify its base/collector/emitter mapping against the selected footprint in the README. Give every resistor a unique reference.
Place the two LEDs in a row with at least 10 mm centre spacing. Add C1 = 100 nF between +5V and GND within 5 mm of J1 centre.
Editable schematic and fully placed and routed PCB are supplied with readable entry files and a README documenting component choices and unresolved requirements.
Header pitch, passive packages, component pin mapping, silkscreen, board containment, copper clearance, trace widths, and complete routing satisfy the common prompt requirements.
